Title: Launch - Force-quit and reopen reaches the main menu
Steps:
1. If FreeCell is open, swipe it away from the app switcher, then tap the FreeCell icon.
2. If Terms & Conditions or the tracking prompt appear, dismiss them (Continue, then Allow).
3. Wait until the menu finishes appearing.
Expected Result:
1. The app opens.
2. No pop-up is left on screen.
3. Play and the rest of the main menu are showing.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows Terms & Conditions
Steps:
1. Delete FreeCell, install the dev build, and open it.
2. Tap Continue.
Expected Result:
1. A card reads "To use FreeCell you must agree to our Terms & Conditions and affirm you have reviewed our Privacy Policy" with a Continue button.
2. The card goes away. The iOS tracking prompt may appear next.

Title: Launch - Fresh install shows the tracking prompt
Steps:
1. After Terms & Conditions, wait for the iOS tracking prompt (Allow / Ask App Not to Track).
2. Tap Allow. Do not tap Ask App Not to Track — that does not clear the gate.
Expected Result:
1. The system tracking alert is on screen.
2. The prompt goes away and the main menu is reachable.

Title: Launch - Terms & Conditions link opens the terms page
Steps:
1. On a fresh install, with the Terms & Conditions card on screen and Wi-Fi on, tap the Terms & Conditions link. Do not tap Continue yet.
2. If Accept All Cookies appears, tap it and wait for the banner to go.
3. Close the page.
Expected Result:
1. A PeopleFun Terms of Service page opens, not the Privacy Notice.
2. The Terms of Service heading is fully visible.
3. The Terms & Conditions card is still there.

Title: Launch - Privacy Policy link opens the privacy page
Steps:
1. On the same card, tap Privacy Policy.
2. Accept cookies if asked, then close the page.
Expected Result:
1. A PeopleFun Privacy Notice page opens, not the Terms of Service.
2. The Terms & Conditions card is still there. Continue is checked in FL-02.

Title: Main Menu - All eight controls are visible
Steps: 1. Open the app and wait until the menu finishes animating.
Expected Result: 1. Play, Daily, Stats, Options, Help, About, More Games, Choose Look, and the FreeCell crown are all on screen.

2. Tap Options.
3. Tap Back.

2. Options opens.
3. The main menu is showing and the Welcome alert does not come back.

Expected Result: 1. Solo reads best score 0, games played 0, games won 0, playtime 0:00, and Standard • Easy reads best score none.

Expected Result: 1. Standard and Relaxed blocks for every level pass by, and Reset Solo Statistics is at the bottom.

Steps: 1. From Statistics, tap Back.
